probes.name: rows_source
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet, item As ChartObject
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
ws.Name = "ChartData" & Worksheets.Count
ws.Cells(1, 1).Value = ""
ws.Cells(1, 2).Value = "Jan"
ws.Cells(1, 3).Value = "Feb"
ws.Cells(2, 1).Value = "Revenue"
ws.Cells(2, 2).Value = 2
ws.Cells(2, 3).Value = 4
ws.Cells(3, 1).Value = "Costs"
ws.Cells(3, 2).Value = 3
ws.Cells(3, 3).Value = 1
Set item = ws.ChartObjects.Add(10, 20, 300, 180)
item.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(3, 3)), xlRows
Probe = item.Chart.PlotBy & ":" & item.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count
Dim i As Long
For i = 1 To item.Chart.SeriesCollection.Count
Probe = Probe & "|" & Replace(item.Chart.SeriesCollection(i).Formula, ws.Name, "Data")
Next
End Function
